stages.text: The notary checks ownership, capacity and property seizure records.

stages.title: Sale agreement
stages.text: Execute the notarised agreement and provide additional special-land documentation where required.

stages.title: Confirm the register result
stages.text: Ask the notary to complete the relevant Centre of Registers formalities and confirm ownership and charge entries.

lithuania.documents: Identity/capacity and property documents requested by the notary; additional agricultural-land evidence where applicable.
lithuania.seller: Make title, capacity and relevant family/property information available to the notary.

sources.label: Lithuanian Chamber of Notaries — purchase and sale, 5 February 2026

luxembourg.binding: A signed compromis is final and binding, subject to its conditions. A preliminary agreement is not mandatory if parties proceed directly to the notary.

stages.title: Agree conditions
stages.text: Identify the parties, property, price and payment terms; agree any financing condition and its deadline.

stages.title: Notarial investigation
stages.text: The notary investigates seller ownership, mortgages, easements and other charges.

stages.title: Authentic instrument
stages.text: Formalise through the notarial instrument that can be registered for third-party enforceability.

luxembourg.documents: Agreement if used, party and cadastral identifiers, financing evidence and notary-requested documents.
luxembourg.seller: Provide title/charge information and specify occupancy and deed timing in the agreement.

malta.binding: The konvenju binds the vendor to the promised sale on agreed terms. Have the notary explain conditions, deposit treatment, expiry and enforcement before signing.

stages.title: Promise of sale
stages.text: Agree the konvenju, including financing, acquisition-permit and property conditions where applicable.

stages.title: Notify and pay provisional duty
stages.text: The notary registers the promise within 21 days with provisional duty equal to 20% of the final duty payable.

stages.title: Publish the final deed
stages.text: The notary submits the transfer information, plans, registry note and applicable buyer duty/seller tax through the portal.

malta.documents: Konvenju, site plans, registry evidence and residential Schedule 8 where applicable; AIP or exemption evidence if relevant.
malta.seller: Make title and site records available and agree how searches, debt and any ground-rent issues will be resolved.

sources.label: Malta Tax and Customs Administration — promise of sale

nationalities.other: Non-EU nationals generally require AIP outside an applicable exemption. SDA acquisitions are exempt from AIP; eligibility to let, operate a business or reside remains a separate question.

netherlands.binding: A purchase contract is followed by a notarial transfer deed. Registered ownership requires the deed to be recorded at Kadaster.

stages.title: Before commitment
stages.text: Have the adviser confirm financing conditions and any statutory withdrawal right applicable to the buyer and dwelling.

stages.title: Transfer deed
stages.text: A Dutch civil-law notary drafts and executes the transfer deed.

stages.title: Record the transfer
stages.text: The notary sends the deed to Kadaster; obtain confirmation of registration.

netherlands.documents: Sale agreement, notarial transfer deed and identity/financing evidence requested by the notary.
netherlands.seller: Agree discharge of charges, possession and any leasehold or local-use issues before transfer.

poland.binding: Have the notary distinguish the preliminary agreement from the final conveyance and confirm the exact title-transfer effect.

stages.title: Eligibility first
stages.text: Obtain the Interior Ministry permit or establish an exemption; assess agricultural and border rules separately.

stages.title: Notarial conveyance
stages.text: Confirm the instrument and permission evidence with the Polish notary before the transfer.

stages.title: Registry application
stages.text: For a covered notarial transfer, the notary submits the electronic land-register application no later than the deed date.

poland.documents: Identity, title/parcel evidence, permit or documented exemption and notary-requested transfer documents.
poland.seller: Provide registered ownership information and resolve relevant charges and consents.

poland.coverage: The notarial filing provision and Ministry permit guidance identify specific checkpoints. Counsel must check the current consolidated law, exemptions, special land and the transfer effect before execution.

nationalities.other: Other foreign nationals normally need the Ministry permit unless exempt. An individual residential-premises exemption may apply, but border-area and agricultural conditions can change the answer.

stages.title: Prepare the legal file

stages.title: Formalise the transfer
stages.text: Choose the legally appropriate conveyancing instrument and tax-payment route with the practitioner; Casa Pronta can combine procedures.

stages.title: Register acquisition
stages.text: A property purchase must be registered. Casa Pronta also handles IMT and Stamp Duty.

stages.title: Prepare the sale file

stages.title: Register and confirm

stages.title: Cadastral approval

slovenia.binding: Ask Slovenian counsel to confirm the binding agreement, certified land-register permission and entry needed for this transaction.

stages.title: Buyer category
stages.text: Determine whether the buyer is in an exempt nationality group, needs a reciprocity decision or cannot use an ordinary purchase route.

stages.title: Contract and permissions
stages.text: Confirm special-land approval, tax, signature and land-register permission requirements before signing.

stages.title: Register the acquisition
stages.text: Have the practitioner file the appropriate documents and verify the land-register entry.

spain.binding: Reservation, arras and private-contract terms can expose a deposit before the public deed. Obtain independent Spanish advice before paying or signing.

stages.title: Before commitment
stages.text: Arrange NIE, title, planning and location checks; assess any restricted military-area permission.

stages.title: Public deed
stages.text: The notary prepares the sale instrument and public deeds. Confirm conditions and tax treatment with independent counsel.

stages.title: Tax and registration
stages.text: Have counsel confirm the regional tax filings and lodge the acquisition with the competent property registry.

spain.documents: NIE, identity, title and planning records, contract and adviser-requested tax/permission documents.
spain.seller: Ask counsel to confirm mortgage cancellation, community liabilities and seller tax obligations.

stages.title: Apply in time

switzerland.binding: Formal execution and registration are governed by the canton. The Solothurn example uses public authentication followed by land-register entry after conditions are met.

stages.title: Lex Koller assessment
stages.text: Obtain the canton’s classification of residence, nationality, intended use and any permission or exemption.

stages.title: Cantonal execution
stages.text: Agree financing and contract details; confirm the competent notarial/public-authentication office in the canton.

stages.title: Register title
stages.text: Complete the cantonal conditions and obtain the ownership entry; Solothurn’s process is an example, not a nationwide office procedure.

switzerland.documents: Identity, residence-permit and financing evidence; canton-specific contract and representation documents.
switzerland.seller: Arrange debt releases and supply title and relevant marital/representation information.

nationalities.other: For non-EU/EFTA residents, main-home conditions, permit status and intended use matter; non-resident foreign buyers generally require cantonal authorisation. No holiday-home approval is guaranteed.

norway.binding: Ask the practitioner to confirm the binding effect of an offer before making it. The deed records the transfer; the deed guide does not settle all contract rules.

stages.title: Resolve the concession
stages.text: Check with the municipality whether a concession or exemption declaration is needed before sending the deed.

stages.title: Prepare the deed
stages.text: Use a new deed with correct ownership shares, signatures, witness formalities and any necessary spousal/lessor consent.

stages.title: Register the transfer
stages.text: Submit the deed; foreign buyers without a Norwegian identity number can request a D-number with the submission.

norway.seller: Supply the transferor signature and required consent; agree treatment of registered charges.

stages.title: Prepare the transfer
stages.text: The attorney/conveyancer arranges the transfer documents. The Cape Town guide identifies title, rates-clearance and transfer-cost work.

stages.title: Tax and non-resident seller
stages.text: Determine Transfer Duty/VAT and any section 35A withholding before paying the full price to a non-resident seller.

south-africa.seller: Arrange municipal clearance and debt release with the conveyancer; confirm any required compliance certificates and non-resident withholding.
